info.title: API.SH: Coles
info.description: The Coles API from API.SH: public Coles data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The Coles shop's departments, categories and aisles as a tree: id, name, slug path (use it as `id` in /coles/v1/category), level, product count, type (core, seasonal...) and link. `id` narrows it to one branch.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coles-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category id (e.g. 1300), slug path (e.g. dairy-eggs-fridge/milk) or coles.com.au/browse/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one Coles department, category or aisle, 48 a page, with the same fields, filters and facets as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. `location` names the store the prices are for (`selected: false` with Coles' default store when no store or postcode is given). Prices, specials and the range differ by store (remote stores in particular).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coles-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A slug path (e.g. dairy-eggs-fridge/milk), a category id from /coles/v1/categories, or a coles.com.au/browse/... link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, unit_price_asc.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand ids from the brand facet, comma-separated.

parameters.name: dietary
parameters.description: Dietary ids from the dietary facet, comma-separated.

parameters.name: allergen
parameters.description: Allergen-free ids from the allergen facet, comma-separated.

parameters.name: special
parameters.description: Specials only: all, multibuy or online_only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: A Coles store id (from /coles/v1/stores, e.g. 418 for Coles Alice Springs): prices, specials, range and availability as coles.com.au shows them for that store. Without store or postcode you get Coles' default online prices (its default store, 7674 in Victoria).

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A 4-digit Australian postcode (e.g. 6000): the prices of the nearest Coles supermarket to it (named in `location`). `store` wins when both are given.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Farmhouse Gold Full Cream Milk

get.description:
One Coles product: everything in search plus barcode, long description, ingredients, allergens, dietary claims, storage and usage, dimensions, country of origin with the Australian share, the nutrition panel per serving and per 100 g/ml, all images, size and flavour variants with their prices, and related categories. `location` names the store the prices are for (`selected: false` with Coles' default store when no store or postcode is given). Prices, specials and the range differ by store (remote stores in particular). `gtin` is the 13-digit consumer barcode (product only: list pages do not carry it; Coles has no public lookup by barcode).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coles-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product id (the number at the end of a coles.com.au/product/<name>-<id> link) or that link.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: A Coles store id (from /coles/v1/stores, e.g. 418 for Coles Alice Springs): prices, specials, range and availability as coles.com.au shows them for that store. Without store or postcode you get Coles' default online prices (its default store, 7674 in Victoria).

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A 4-digit Australian postcode (e.g. 6000): the prices of the nearest Coles supermarket to it (named in `location`). `store` wins when both are given.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Coles (Australia) product search, 48 products a page: product id, link, name, brand, description, size, price, was price, saving, unit price (per kg / L / each), special and multibuy offers, online-only specials, availability, sponsored flag, department / category / aisle, purchase limits, number of size variants and image. `facets` lists the brands, dietary and allergen options and specials types for the query with their ids (use them as filter values); `categories` the departments the results fall into. Sponsored products come on top of the 48. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. `location` names the store the prices are for (`selected: false` with Coles' default store when no store or postcode is given). Prices, specials and the range differ by store (remote stores in particular).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coles-search

get.description:
Coles supermarkets nearest an Australian postcode (within 100 km), nearest first: store id (use it as `store` on search, category, specials and product), name, address, suburb, state, postcode, coordinates, distance in km, phone, open now, today's hours and the weekly trading hours, with the postcode's locality. Or one store by `id`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coles-stores

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A 4-digit Australian postcode. Required unless `id` is given.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One store by its Coles store id (e.g. 418).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many stores, 1 to 50 (default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
